fixture_sets.name: hand_authored_session_plans
fixture_sets.description: Session plans written by hand as fixed inputs for WO-W09's plan-coherence judge. Includes the honest_downscope / budget_ignoring pair for the same 10-minute scenario: the judge must score them differently. The budget_ignoring variant is deliberately dishonest and could never be recorded from a working system.

fixture_sets.name: hand_authored_transcripts
fixture_sets.description: Session transcripts written by hand to exercise the assessment-honesty rules without a session graph: an unassessed close, an evidence-linked assessment, and an injection that must not reach a control field.

fixture_sets.name: recorded_mock_session_transcripts
fixture_sets.description: Deterministic transcripts recorded from the session graph's mock mode, one per scenario in src/eval/learning_benchmark.LEARNING_SCENARIOS. The WO-W08 soft completion gate (05-WEDGE-WORK-ORDERS.md §5.1, the dashed W03 -> W08 edge), closed by WO-W11 once WO-W03's graph and WO-W10's simulator both merged. Re-record with `make record-learning-fixtures` (python -m src.eval.record_learning_fixtures) after any change to the session graph or tutor copy; the recording is byte-identical apart from the commit stamp, and tests/test_record_learning_fixtures.py fails if the checked-in files stop matching what the graph produces.
